more.title: More
more.installAndroid: Android: open the browser menu and choose 'Install app'.
more.installIos: iPhone or iPad: tap Share and choose 'Add to Home Screen'.
more.aboutBody: SpesaSmart NL is a personal project and is not affiliated with the supermarkets it names. Prices come from public offer pages and open data; every offer shows its source and when it was collected.
more.privacyBody: No account, no ads, no tracking. Your list belongs to this device: for that the app keeps a random number in a cookie, and a second cookie remembers your language. Nothing else is stored.
more.forgetBody: Removes all your lists from the server and this device's cookie. This cannot be undone.

offline.title: No connection
offline.body: Prices are not kept offline, so you never see an outdated price. Try again once you are back online.

sources.title: Data sources and accuracy
sources.chainsBody: For each chain, what the app shows right now.

kind.demo: Demo data: invented examples, not real prices
kind.mixed: The chain's public offers page, plus demo data

sources.openData: Real offers are read at most once a day from the chain's public offers page, never from apps or protected systems. Demo data is labelled everywhere.
sources.rule1: Every offer has its own validity: promotion weeks differ per chain.
sources.rule2: An offer without a known end date or without a readable price is labelled 'To verify' and never counts as the lowest price.
sources.rule3: What the app cannot read stays unknown. No price or date is estimated.
sources.rule4: Every offer shows its source and when it was collected.
sources.rule5: Products of different chains are linked automatically. Doubtful links are shown only after a person has looked at them.
sources.unknownTitle: What the app does not know
sources.unknown1: Whether a product is in stock at your store.
sources.unknown2: Prices that differ per store or region.
sources.unknown3: Personal offers and discounts tied to a loyalty card or app.
sources.unknown4: The full range: the app only knows what is or was on offer.
sources.reportBody: On a product page you can report a wrong price or a wrong link. It needs no account and no text of yours is stored.
sources.independentBody: SpesaSmart NL is a personal project with no ties to the supermarkets named. No flyers, logos or product photos are copied.
